title: Unstructuring a parametrized generic fails in modules with deferred annotations
text_original: Fixes #661. Fix unstructuring of generic classes with stringified annotations.
text_rewritten: Every module in our codebase opts into deferred annotations, so the field types on our models are strings at runtime. Unstructuring a generic model with the parametrized form as the target dies with `TypeError: ...Envelope[int] is not a module, class, method, or function.` Nothing is wrong with the model itself: the same model unstructures fine when the module does not defer its annotations, and a non-generic model in the same deferred module unstructures fine too. It looks like the annotation resolution step is handed the parametrized form instead of the class it came from.
body: Every module in our codebase opts into deferred annotations, so the field types on our models are strings at runtime. Unstructuring a generic model with the parametrized form as the target dies with `TypeError: ...Envelope[int] is not a module, class, method, or function.` Nothing is wrong with the model itself: the same model unstructures fine when the module does not defer its annotations, and a non-generic model in the same deferred module unstructures fine too. It looks like the annotation resolution step is handed the parametrized form instead of the class it came from.
acceptance_hint: Unstructuring a value against a parametrized generic target produces the same primitive payload it would produce without deferred annotations, for single- and multi-parameter generics, and non-generic models in the same module are unaffected.
